Moreover, auxiliary variables containing rich domain-specific information are often underutilized, especially in few-shot settings. To address these challenges …

papers.title: Shadow splitting methods for nonconvex optimisation: epi-approximation, convergence and saddle point avoidance
papers.abstract: We propose the shadow Davis-Yin three-operator splitting method to solve nonconvex optimisation problems. We explore variational analysis properties behind the merit function and the iteration operators associated with the shadow method.
